lines.zh: 我一步一步走近那道门
lines.en: I come step by step toward that door

lines.zh: 两条腿走得很慢但不停
lines.en: Two legs, slow but never stopping
My shadow climbs the door frame first

lines.zh: 我在门外站定，等你回头
lines.en: I stop outside the door and wait for you to turn
My bones stretch long under the skin
I cross the gravel in the yard
I walk the fence line, looking for a gap
I turn sideways against the door gap

lines.zh: 我隔着墙也能听见你呼吸
lines.en: I can hear you breathe through the wall
Night is my best cover

lines.zh: 我走过的地方没有虫叫
lines.en: No insects chirp where I pass

lines.zh: 我把头压得很低才进门
lines.en: I duck low to get through the doorway
I stand in the doorway without moving

lines.zh: 我的手指在门框上轻轻敲
lines.en: My fingers tap softly on the frame
I count the sounds inside your house
I tilt my head and my neck clicks
I am waiting for the lamp to go out
My breathing is slow, almost inaudible

lines.zh: 我就这么看着那扇双开门
lines.en: I just watch that double door
At night I am never in a hurry

lines.zh: 我贴着墙站着，像根柱子
lines.en: I stand against the wall like a post
I am counting the beats of your heart
I still have time before dawn

lines.zh: 我一动不动地守着门缝
lines.en: I guard the door gap without moving

lines.zh: 我的影子在门缝下面爬
lines.en: My shadow crawls under the door gap
I lift a foot and set it down, slowly
You finally turned around
I have been behind you all along
Your door gap is still open a crack
Do not light the lamp

lines.zh: 我从双开门的缝里挤进来。
lines.en: I squeeze in through the gap in the double door.

lines.zh: 你看见我的时候，已经晚了
lines.en: When you see me, it is already too late
My face is at your window
I do not blink, you do
You have no weapon, do you

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我听来很响
lines.en: Your steps sound very loud to me
I need not run, you cannot outrun me
Back into the corner, I prefer that
I tilt my head at you, a long while
One corner of my mouth moved
Have you counted to three
I can vault the fence around your house

lines.zh: 你听见的那声脚步就是我
lines.en: That footstep you heard was mine
I am closer than yesterday

lines.zh: 我被打退了一步，仅此一步
lines.en: I am driven back one step, only one

lines.zh: 一百点生命不是白给的
lines.en: A hundred health is not given for nothing

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，好像不在意
lines.en: I tilt my head as if I do not care
That blow made me remember you
One of my bones clicked
Very little blood, you can barely see it
I do not cry out, and I do not retreat
Your strength is decent
I will return that blow
I stand here and take it

lines.zh: 我不用吃你手里的东西
lines.en: I do not need what you are holding
You hold it up hoping to stop me
My appetite is not for that
Put your hand back
That thing will not stop me
The more you do this, the closer I come
I am not hungry, I just want in
Leave it on the table and step back

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我照样翻过栅栏。
lines.en: Torch in hand or not, I still climb the fence.
I am not here tonight for food
You bumped into me, cold, is it not
My bones press against your shoulder
You need not push, I step back on my own
The door creaked as I squeezed against it
My skin has no warmth

lines.zh: 你退开的时候我还站着
lines.en: When you back away, I am still standing
One touch and you will remember
You knocked me askew, I straighten again
Bumping me will not help you
We are closer than yesterday
I have only one thing to do
You asked the wrong question
I have no companions and need none
My nights hold only doors and gaps

lines.zh: 这个念头让我偏了偏头
lines.en: That thought made me tilt my head
I will always stand alone

lines.zh: 别提这个，我听着不舒服
lines.en: Do not bring it up, it unsettles me
I turn my face back to the door
I go on waiting outside the door

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的东西，看了看
lines.en: I pick up what fell and look at it
You dropped this, did you not
I hold it, my knuckles pale
I set it by the door
I do not need it, but I want to hold it
This thing is mine now
I close it into my palm
It will stay at your doorstep
I look at it for a long time
I drop it
You moved at last
I heard your door open
This is the direction
I turn my body square to it

lines.zh: 一百点生命，我不怕挨打
lines.en: A hundred health, I do not fear blows

lines.zh: 你也听见那声脚步了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that footstep too
I have marked you down
Only a few steps from here to the door
You cannot outrun this house
I crouch, ready to vault over

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里很亮
lines.en: My eyes are bright in the dark
I have chosen my way in
You heard the door
I am coming in now
I follow you along the base of the wall
You are behind the window, I am outside it
I shorten the distance step by step
My shadow is already inside
Changing rooms will not help
I look in through the door gap
I am waiting for you to open it
You are breathing too fast

lines.zh: 我的脚步声就是给你听的
lines.en: My footsteps are for you to hear

lines.zh: 你退到最里面的角落了
lines.en: You have backed into the farthest corner
No need to hurry, the night is long

lines.zh: 我把手指从门缝伸进去
lines.en: I slide a finger through the door gap
Your dog dares not bark
I listened outside your door all night
I press to the wall, waiting for you to turn

lines.zh: 你每走一步我就进一寸
lines.en: Every step you take, I gain an inch

lines.zh: 这栋房子的结构我记住了
lines.en: I have memorized this house
Listen, I am a little closer

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的灯在晃
lines.en: I see the lamp shaking in your hand

lines.zh: 我的手从门缝里伸进来
lines.en: My hand reaches in through the door gap
This grab lands on your shoulder
I vault the fence and come down
Seven points of force, not light
I pin your wrist
You did not block that one

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往里拖
lines.en: I grab your collar and drag you in
My fingers are long and cold

lines.zh: 我出手之后又退回暗处
lines.en: I strike, then slip back into the dark
You are shoved into the door frame
This blow came from behind
My hands need no tool

lines.zh: 你倒下去的时候我还在站着
lines.en: When you fall, I am still standing
I drag you toward the door
I press you against the wall
I appear outside a double door

lines.zh: 夜色把我从地里托起来
lines.en: The night lifts me out of the ground
My bones straighten joint by joint
I am a little taller than yesterday

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里没有雾
lines.en: My breath makes no mist in the cold air
I stop as soon as I reach the door
A few days ago I did not exist

lines.zh: 门缝开多宽，我就挤多宽。
lines.en: However wide the door opens, I fit.
I turn sideways and squeeze into the door gap
Your lamp is still on

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你床上
lines.en: My shadow falls on your bed first

lines.zh: 四面的声音都被我吸走了
lines.en: I have swallowed every sound around
I lower my head below the lintel

lines.zh: 我在门外的雪地上留下脚印
lines.en: I leave footprints in the snow outside
I look at that door for a long time
This night will not be peaceful

lines.zh: 你听见的那阵风其实是我
lines.en: The gust you heard was really me

lines.zh: 我在你屋外站好了位置
lines.en: I have taken my place outside your house
I wait for you to blow out the lamp
I never knock

lines.zh: 火光让我退了一步，皮在烧
lines.en: The firelight pushed me back, my skin burns

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，骨头错位
lines.en: I fell from a height and my bones slipped

lines.zh: 水进了我的喉咙，我不需要呼吸也很难受
lines.en: Water filled my throat, I need no air but it still stings

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来又摔下
lines.en: The blast lifted me and dropped me

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进我肩里
lines.en: A missile bit into my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量在我身体里转
lines.en: That power turns inside my body
I long ago forgot what hunger is

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整片院子，我被烧到
lines.en: Lightning lit the whole yard and burned me
The ground beneath me is gone
